2025 HillClimb Dates

September 23, 2024February 28, 2025 HillClimbUK News

Here are the dates announced for the 2025 hillclimb season.

This post will be updated as more clubs release their dates.

The page begins with the main hillclimb championships, then schedules for each venue and finally a timeline to help you to load dates into your calendar or spot clashing events.
